Price stability can be said to occur if the measured value of the consumer prices index (CPI) is unchanged during the year. Which statement is correct?

options.A: For price stability to occur, there must be no changes in prices of any products.
options.B: For price stability to occur, the number of products whose prices rise must exactly match the number whose prices fall.
options.C: If some prices rise and others fall, there cannot be price stability.
options.D: Different weightings of items used in the calculation of CPI mean that price stability can occur in many ways.

questions.questionText: Based on the circular flow of income, which condition is necessary for an open economy to be in equilibrium?

options.C: Spending by households is equal to taxes collected by government.
options.D: Value of export earnings is equal to expenditure on imports.

options.C: If the price level is high, any interest rate changes will encourage consumption.
options.D: The real value of assets increases as the price level falls.
